facts.fact: The CAIDP president recalled law n°2013-867, adopted in 2013, which guarantees every citizen the right of access to public information, and described it as the law the commission now works to apply.
facts.system: Loi n°2013-867 relative à l'accès à l'information d'intérêt public

facts.fact: The Commission d'Accès à l'Information d'Intérêt Public et aux Documents Publics (CAIDP) is in place with a named president, who presented the ACCESS CAIDP programme on 25 July 2025; the document gives no date for the commission's own set-up, so its published date is used.
facts.system: Loi n°2013-867 relative à l'accès à l'information d'intérêt public
